newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH 28.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH 28.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- The Hungarian army will withdraw from service the MIG-21 F, MIG-23 M and SU-22 types of aircraft from today.
- Who's responsible? - ask citizens of Budakeszi, who are extremely shocked after roof of a former Russian military warehouse collapsed causing the death of three children.
- GPs, threatening to strike, are trying to sign an agreement with the minister of welfare.
- Miners in Markushegy gave a deadline of April 11 to managers of the state owned company to arrange their working conditions.

- Hungarian journalists who suffered an accident near Bagdad in Iraq, may leave the hospital in a week's time. The crew's cameraman died in Thursday's accident which was caused by unauthorised turning.
